name: Recorder
intro: Recorder lets you record your webcam and screen together right in the browser, then turn the takes into a polished video with captions and scenes.

features.record: Choose a device for each view, then start recording. Webcam and screen are saved as separate files, so the editor can lay them out for you.
features.camera-effects: On the webcam view, the sparkle button offers blur, office, studio and gradient backgrounds, plus touch-up, so you can hide your room and look polished.
features.teleprompter: The teleprompter button shows your script over the camera preview and scrolls it while you record. It's only on your screen, never in the video.
features.scenes: Scenes are the building blocks of your video, like takes, a title, a table of contents and an end card. Reorder them with the arrows.
features.captions: Captions are made in your browser after each take. Click any word in the preview to correct it.
features.export: Export video renders everything into one finished file, with a progress bar and a Stop button if you change your mind.

outro: That's Recorder. Record in one sitting, polish in the same place, and walk away with a finished video without a separate editor.
